tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: The night's marquee game, and an NBA Cup group game on Prime Video. Philadelphia is 8-1 with five straight wins and 4-0 on the road, with LeBron James running point-forward next to Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown and Joel Embiid — Embiid is playing through a foot issue and is expected to go. Cleveland is the more banged-up side: Jarrett Allen is questionable (knee contusion), Jaylon Tyson is out for a fourth straight game, and Proctor and Watson are questionable, after the Cavs dropped two straight to Oklahoma City. The market has it about right — no US price clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge here, but the lean is Philadelphia, the healthier and hotter team, to win outright in Cleveland.
games.title: NBA Cup: 76ers at Cavaliers
games.verdict: LEAN: PHI -2.5 — no true edge at -142, but the lean is Philadelphia, the healthier and hotter team.

games.take: Two 6-2 teams and an NBA Cup group game in Memphis. Oklahoma City is the class of the West and its defense travels; Memphis is 6-2 and tough at home, so this is a real test of whether the Grizzlies belong in the top tier. The market has it about right — no US price clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge here, but the lean is Oklahoma City to win outright: the better team, the better defense, and the number still leaves a little room at -4.
games.title: NBA Cup: Thunder at Grizzlies
games.verdict: LEAN: OKC -4 — no true edge at -159, but the lean is Oklahoma City, the better team with the better defense.

games.matchup: Portland Trail Blazers (6-1) @ Los Angeles Lakers (7-2)
games.our_fair: Lakers 58.8% / Trail Blazers 41.2% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: Two of the West's hottest starts meet in the late Prime Video window: Portland is 6-1, the Lakers are 7-2, and both are playing Cup basketball tonight. The Lakers are a short home favorite and the market has it about right — no US price clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge here, but the lean is the Lakers at home: 7-2, the deeper roster, and the home court in a game both teams will treat like a playoff atmosphere.
games.title: NBA Cup: Trail Blazers at Lakers
games.verdict: LEAN: LAL -3 — no true edge at -150, but the lean is the Lakers at home in the late window.

games.matchup: TCU Horned Frogs (4-4) @ No. 22 Arizona Wildcats (6-2)
games.our_fair: Wildcats 71.8% / Horned Frogs 28.2% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: This one is on the board, not just a lean: FanDuel hangs Arizona -245 against a 71.8% fair line, a +1.1% edge. Noah Fifita leads the Big 12's top passing attack at 324.1 yards per game with 19 touchdowns, and Arizona scores 34.9 per game. TCU's defense is legit — best in the Big 12 at 14.1 points allowed — but the Frogs score just 23.3 per game, their running-back room is banged up, and a locker-room virus has hit 25-30 players on a short week. Arizona is also short two defensive starters (safety Cam Chapa, corner Jay'Vion Cole), so this is priced as a shootout the Wildcats win at home, not a blowout. Weather is a non-factor: partly cloudy, mid-60s in Tucson, no NWS alerts.
games.title: Friday Night Lights: TCU at No. 22 Arizona
games.venue: Casino Del Sol Stadium, Tucson, AZ
games.verdict: LEAN: ARIZ — and this one clears the board: Arizona -245 at FanDuel is a +1.1% edge vs the devigged Pinnacle fair line.
games.weather: Partly cloudy, mid-60s at kickoff; no NWS alerts in Tucson

games.our_fair: Cornhuskers 63.3% / Fighting Illini 36.7% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: Friday night in Champaign on FOX. Nebraska is a 4.5-point road favorite, which tells you how the market rates these two — the Huskers are the better team and the line has them winning by more than a field goal away from home. The market has it about right, though: no US price clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge here, but the lean is Nebraska to win outright and cover the short road number.
games.title: Big Ten Friday: Nebraska at Illinois
games.verdict: LEAN: NEB -4.5 — no true edge at -181, but the lean is Nebraska, the better team, on the road.
games.weather: No NWS watch or warning in Champaign; no weather factor expected

games.title: ACC Friday: Virginia Tech at SMU
